incidents.name: Ransomware during a sold-out stadium event
incidents.affected_assets: Office endpoints, shared files and ticketing support. Verify turnstile and BMS exposure.
incidents.owner: CISO (response lead per A1); SOC coordinates triage
incidents.source: A1 PDF p. 4; A3 PDF pp. 9–10

incident_stages.action: Maintain contacts, backups, SIEM intake, ticket fallback, MFA and awareness.
Correlate admin logins, user reports and endpoint changes. Notify Stadium Operations.
Scope accounts and systems, check OT exposure and possible data loss.
incident_stages.evidence: Endpoint, IAM, firewall, VPN, server and cloud logs

incident_stages.action: Isolate affected IT endpoints, disable compromised sessions, coordinate safety-system protection and use ticket fallback as needed.
Rebuild affected hosts, patch gaps, rotate affected credentials and verify other systems.
Restore identity and network first, then service priorities. Monitor and use DR if needed.
incident_stages.evidence: Restore record, measured downtime and data loss

incident_stages.action: Review detection, MFA, segmentation, recovery and communication. Assign fixes and deadlines.
